text: Mrs. Alice Shaw, the society siffleuse, opened her American season with a whistling recital before a fashionable audience.
Alice Shaw whistled selections from the opera at Music Hall; her pure tone drew repeated encores.
The celebrated whistler Mrs. Shaw appeared at the Academy of Music, her artistic whistling much admired.
Alice Shaw, whistling soloist, charmed a large house with imitations of birds and popular airs.
Mrs. Shaw closed her tour on the coast, her whistling pronounced the finest ever heard in the city.
Agnes Woodward opened her school of artistic whistling, training young women in the warbling art.
Miss Woodward gave a whistling demonstration, her pupils performing bird calls and melodies.
A recital of artistic whistling by Agnes Woodward delighted the fair crowds.
The California whistler Agnes Woodward lectured on whistling as a serious musical art.
Agnes Woodward brought her whistling method east, performing to a curious metropolitan audience.
Margaret McKee, whistling soprano, astonished listeners with her range and trills.
The whistling artist Margaret McKee appeared at the Orpheum, her warbling encored thrice.
Margaret McKee whistled popular songs and bird imitations to a packed vaudeville house.
McKee's whistling recital was the talk of the season; critics praised her flute-like tone.
The famous whistler Margaret McKee gave a benefit concert of whistled airs.
Margaret McKee concluded her tour with a whistling program at a Broadway theatre.
Bob MacGimsey, a whistler of unusual skill, performed his three-note whistling before a delighted crowd.
MacGimsey whistled spirituals and folk airs, his technique drawing wide notice.
The whistling composer Bob MacGimsey demonstrated his bird-like warbling on stage.
Bob MacGimsey's whistling performance mixed melody and imitation to great effect.
A whistling recital by MacGimsey closed the summer series at the hall.
MacGimsey brought his whistling act to New York, where audiences marveled at his control.
Fred Lowery, the blind whistler, performed popular tunes with remarkable accuracy.
Fred Lowery whistled with a dance orchestra, his clear tone soaring above the band.
The whistling virtuoso Fred Lowery appeared on the radio hour to wide acclaim.
Fred Lowery's whistling of the Indian Love Call became a sensation in the city.
Fred Lowery whistled for the pictures, his artistry sought by Hollywood studios.
A locomotive whistled in the yards; the long steam whistle echoed through the smoky valley.
At dawn the mockingbird's whistling filled the garden, answered by a distant thrush.
